listing.title: Rhodesian Ridgeback Tombstone Plaque with a Graphics, Ceramic plate with Geometric Dog, Memorial Plaque
listing.description:
In short:
- A tombstone plaque commemorating your dog.
- The fashionable pattern with a geometric dog face.
- Dimensions: 10 x 7 centimeters (3.9 x 2.7 inches)
- A solid imprint is resistant to abrasion and fading.
- All items are shipped with a courier - we want to be sure that your order reaches you in the shortest possible time!

Having a dog is what guarantees the best day in one’s lifetime, when their dog becomes the family member, but also the worst day in a lifetime, when that family member passes away. Commemorate the look of your wonderful dog on a ceramic tombstone plaque. The tombstone plaque has a smooth, oval finish, and so does not need any setting extra.

We can customize plaques according to your instructions. We can use a photo of your dog and print it in original full color. If you want to add name of the dog or dates, that will not be any problem for us! Just let us know about your preferences.
We are sorry but we do not customize geometric dogs basing on the photo.

Art-Dog is proud to present an entirely new collection of items for all dog enthusiasts. The fashionable and designer graphics of geometric dog faces imprinted on the ceramic tombstone plaque will help farewell your pet with dignity.
